title: Prospect of Middle East peace talks pushes oil lower
section_path: Prospect of Middle East peace talks pushes oil lower
section_path_text: Prospect of Middle East peace talks pushes oil lower
summary:
Main
The prospect of peace talks in the Middle East pushed the energy sector lower. The rest of the complex also fell amid subdued risk appetite from investors. Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-07-29 102916.png | assets/2026-07-29_prospect-of-middle-east-peace-talks-pushes-oil-lower_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_dd23cb02c196.png

Market Commentary
Crude oil extended recent losses as traders positioned for potential progress towards peace talks in the Middle East conflict.
